theorem p05 : ¬ ∃ q : ℚ, q * q = 2 := by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have h2 : ((q : ℝ)) ^ 2 = 2 := by
    rw [sq]
    exact_mod_cast hq
  have h3 : Real.sqrt 2 = |(q : ℝ)| := by
    rw [← h2, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  have h4 : Real.sqrt 2 = ((|q| : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [h3, Rat.cast_abs]
  exact irrational_sqrt_two ⟨|q|, h4.symm⟩
